paragraphs: He spoke in Rabbi Yochanan’s name. See [Berakhot 63a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.63a.18).[^1]

notes.text: The linked Berakhot gives Chizkiyah son of Rabbi Parnakh speaking in Rabbi Yochanan’s name about the juxtaposition of two Torah passages.
